title: Ra-Tet
summary: Ra-Tet is a Sun-powered Hecto-Titan who has been missing for thousands of years. Not much has been uncovered about this Titan aside from it being the rival Titan of Slitherfang.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*This Titan is most likely based on the Egyptian sun god, [[wikipedia:Ra|Ra]], half man, half falcon. 
*It is possible that Ra-Tet is the [[Unnamed Titan 007|Unnamed Hecto-Titan]] used by [[Lok Lambert]] seen in the card ''[[TCG:SAS-108|Decoding]]'', its appearance being similar to that of Ra. Furthermore, "Tet" may be an allusion to the god Thoth, who is half-man, half-Ibis, as seen on the card.
